title: The Safflower Baths of Stamp Day
description: On Stamp Day, the makers dip each oversized stamp in safflower dye. The red creeps up the paper while the engraved bird stays blue.
alt: A maker lowers a giant postage stamp with a blue bird into a copper bath of red dye while another hangs stamps to dry.
pairing: An imagined stamp collectors’ holiday × dye baths for oversized postage stamps
